inputs: ordinary-explanation attack results (P11 concept) passed in as inputs; P11 not imported
negative_results: A residual below combined uncertainty is never anomalous; it is a KNOWN_ORDINARY_EFFECT even when it survives every attack.
Missing or invalid calibration forces CALIBRATION_ERROR (invalid) before any anomaly is considered, regardless of residual size.
The ceiling for an unreplicated residual that survives every ordinary-explanation attack is UNEXPLAINED_INSTRUMENT_RESIDUAL; it is not new physics and not a detection.
One run, one lab, or non-independent replication cannot reach REPLICATED_ANOMALY (requires >=2 distinct independent, confirming labs).
refuse_residual_as_new_physics, refuse_unexplained_as_replicated_without_replication, and refuse_phryll_detected all raise; there is no PHRYLL_DETECTED state.
No physical measurement was performed; measured_here is nothing and PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED.
reopening_test: Reopen the residual classifier if: a residual below combined uncertainty is ever classified as anomalous; an uncalibrated residual escapes CALIBRATION_ERROR; a residual that survives every attack and exceeds combined uncertainty is classified as anything other than UNEXPLAINED_INSTRUMENT_RESIDUAL when unreplicated; or any single lab / single run reaches REPLICATED_ANOMALY. An UNEXPLAINED_INSTRUMENT_RESIDUAL is reopened only by independent replication in at least 2 distinct laboratories, each confirming the residual survives the full ordinary-explanation battery.
